name: free-web-tools
description: Free Web Tools Aggregator — Code snippets, video tutorials, community reviews

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,yellow "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:backend"
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.typecheck: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../backend && npx tsc --noEmit
